builds.name: Summon Tibbers impact ceiling
builds.summary: Seek the highest damage from Summon Tibbers impact within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.goal: Seek the highest damage from Summon Tibbers impact within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.hypothesis: R3 summon hit is400+0.75 AP; R passive supplies20% magic penetration, so AP and MR penetration strengthen initial impact. Deathcap multiplies AP; earned Seraph supplies mana and observed Awe AP. Zhonya/Banshee each add105AP. Void provides40% MR penetration; Shadowflame provides15 flat MR penetration and20% eligible low-health magic amplification. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

Same-patch practice/custom test with exact state: record Summon Tibbers impact tooltip, observed AP/AD/HP/mana/resists, per-packet damage/protection and final targetHP. Compare one legal item swap at a time, separating setup damage, rune/item procs and ordinary attack. Verify raw helper/statFormula mappings and conditional multipliers before treating result as established.

Rune reasoning: Annie — Summon Tibbers impact: Use adaptive stats for the actual damage helper and a finisher matching the starting enemy/owner HP. The keystone proc is measured separately; damage type alone does not justify attack speed, crit, or an ultimate modifier. Ability basis: R3 summon hit is400+0.75 AP; R passive supplies20% magic penetration, so AP and MR penetration strengthen initial impact. Deathcap multiplies AP; earned Seraph supplies mana and observed Awe AP. Zhonya/Banshee each add105AP. Void provides40% MR penetration; Sh Arcane Comet: Comet is separate damage and can miss; target movement and range affect the comparison. Axiom Arcanist: Eligibility-tested ultimate modifier; classification and true/pet/on-hit/revive exceptions are not inferred from slot alone. Absolute Focus: Adaptive stats only while owner stays above 70% HP (starts at 100%). Gathering Storm: Fixed minute-30 adaptive stats (or the authored time), never an infinite-time ceiling. Legend: Haste: Cooldown utility; no extra casts inside a one-cast benchmark. Coup de Grace: Eligible non-true damage only below 40% victim HP; not active on a healthy first hit.

Rune preparation: Axiom targets eligible native ultimate output. Check single-target versus area classification, and pet/on-hit/transform/true-damage exceptions. Its takedown refund is not extra damage inside one fixed cast. Gathering Storm fixed at authored minute 30; no extra game time.

Rune comparison: Compare a real prepared Conqueror page versus the selected page without changing target defenses, HP, earned item stacks, rank or time. Additional rune preparation must be its own recorded trial. Compare First Strike or a damage keystone only in a separately reported total-hit result; proc damage is outside the named native packet.

Stat shards: Offense adaptive force feeds only the actual AD/AP coefficient and uses real adaptive-type conversion. Flex adaptive force targets the stated AD/AP coefficient. Defense scaling health is 180 HP at level 18, rather than the old 65-HP shard.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The form loads the recorded target slot and any explicit benchmark overrides; other fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR). Adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.

tradeoffs: Six final items explicitly replace late-game boots; slower access/escape, extreme cost and setup dependence. Raw-number candidate sacrifices practical positioning and does not prove a global maximum.
Confidence: plausible. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Annie gains [(0.1 / 0.15 / 0.2) × 100]% Magic Penetration.

Annie summons her bear Tibbers, dealing [150 / 275 / 400 + (0.75) × AP] magic damage. For the next [45] seconds, Tibbers burns nearby enemies for [8 / 12 / 16 + (0.04) × AP] magic damage per second.

Tibbers becomes enraged when summoned, if Annie stuns an enemy champion, and if Annie dies. When enraged, Tibbers gains 275% Attack Speed and 100% Move Speed decaying over 3 seconds.

Recast: Manually issue orders to Tibbers.

builds.name: Molten Shield: caster and Tibbers retaliation test
builds.summary: Investigate high Molten Shield retaliation from one paired caster-pet hit output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high Molten Shield retaliation from one paired caster-pet hit output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Each eligible shield retaliation deals 25/35/45/55/65 + 0.4 AP magic, once per attacker per shield according to the tooltip. Tibbers can receive Molten Shield effects. Whether one enemy can trigger independent retaliation from both Annie and Tibbers is the interaction to test, not a guaranteed double multiplier.

Annie grants an ally champion [60 / 95 / 130 / 165 / 200 + (0.4) × AP] Shield for [3] seconds and [characterLevelInterpolation(0.2 → 0.5; raw flags preserved)] Decaying Move Speed for [1.5] seconds.
